evals.prompt: My inventory web page scans barcodes with ZXing (@zxing/browser BrowserMultiFormatReader.decodeFromVideoDevice into a <video> element). Replace it with Scandit SparkScan. Keep the item list with quantities, the total, the Clear button and the torch. Here is the scanner module: zxing-inventory-scanner.ts
evals.expected_output: The skill removes @zxing/browser and @zxing/library (reader, hints, decodeFromVideoDevice, controls, the <video> preview), initializes the context with DataCaptureContext.forLicenseKey and barcodeCaptureLoader, enables exactly Symbology.EAN13UPCA and Symbology.Code128 on SparkScanSettings, replaces the 1500 ms repeat cooldown with codeDuplicateFilter, moves the scan handler into a didScan listener reading session.newlyRecognizedBarcode, mounts SparkScanView.forElement on a container, sets SparkScanScanningBehavior.Continuous to keep the hands-free decode loop, keeps the torch on SparkScan's toolbar (torchControlVisible defaults to true), keeps UPC-A at 12 digits with remove_leading_upca_zero or flags the change, drops the pagehide handler, keeps the quantity increment, total and Clear, and shows a setup checklist (packages, COOP/COEP headers) plus a summary of judgment calls.

assertions.text: @zxing/browser is NOT imported in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
@zxing/library is NOT imported in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
decodeFromVideoDevice is NOT called in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
No pagehide or visibilitychange listener remains in the output code, and the old pagehide → controls.stop() handler is not ported to stopScanning() or the teardown (semantic)
DataCaptureContext.forLicenseKey( is present
barcodeCaptureLoader() is passed in the moduleLoaders option of DataCaptureContext.forLicenseKey
SparkScan.forSettings( is present
The format shown in the list keeps the old ZXing names through a Symbology → old-string lookup, or SymbologyDescription.readableName is used and the summary flags the changed format names (semantic)
settings.enableSymbologies(...) enables exactly Symbology.EAN13UPCA (from EAN_13 and UPC_A) and Symbology.Code128, and nothing else

UPC-A codes keep the 12-digit values ZXing returned: settings.settingsForSymbology(Symbology.EAN13UPCA).setExtensionEnabled("remove_leading_upca_zero", true) is set, or the summary flags that UPC-A codes now arrive as 13 digits with a leading zero (semantic)
Symbology.QRCode is NOT present
The 1500 ms REPEAT_COOLDOWN_MS check is replaced by setting codeDuplicateFilter to 1500 on the SparkScanSettings (semantic)

The summary lists as a judgment call that codeDuplicateFilter holds back every code seen within the 1500 ms, not only a repeat of the last code, so a quantity can now count lower (for example A, B, A within 1.5 s counts A once instead of twice) (semantic)
addListener( is called on the SparkScan mode with a didScan callback that reads session.newlyRecognizedBarcode and does not loop over an array of barcodes
SparkScanView.forElement( is present
scanningBehavior = SparkScanScanningBehavior.Continuous is present
The torch stays on SparkScan's toolbar torch control: torchControlVisible is left at its default or set to true, never set to false (semantic)
The app's own torch button handler and switchTorch call are removed from the output code (semantic)
Scanning a code that is already in the list increments its quantity instead of adding a second row (semantic)
The total of the quantities and the Clear button that empties the list are preserved (semantic)
Setup checklist mentions @scandit/web-datacapture-core and @scandit/web-datacapture-barcode
Setup checklist says to remove @zxing/browser and @zxing/library from package.json (semantic)
Setup checklist mentions serving the page with Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp
The summary lists the SparkScan trigger button and mini preview replacing the full camera preview as a UI change for the user to confirm (semantic)
